declared.map: real generateMap(1, 0, {decor:false}); mapHashU32 recorded in each case
declared.world: real createGameWorld production module order; quests on, mobs on, signatures off, walkHints off; declared seats via addPlayer; ordinary 50 ms step()
declared.seats: p0/p2 declared humans, p1 declared bot for the standard cases; p0 human + p1/p2 bots for the camp-clear pair. Bots are declared directly with bot:true and never connect a profile or join.
declared.positions: every player x/y, hp and weapon change is a declared trusted placement and is recorded in each case setup; the sim reads them as the server position
declared.inputs: every command is the real enqueueClientMessage into the real InputQueue, applied by the real action handler during the ordinary step
declared.producers: the camp-clear producer is the real killMob for every live regional mob with no credited killer, the same whole-region path used by tools/quest-fixtures/lifecycle.mts; the human departure in the bot-only camp world is a real player-kill attack
declared.events: every toast/questReveal/gv(reason=quest) row is a real SimEvent returned by step() or drained after a declared producer
declared.ordinary: no expected offer, acceptance, progress, ready state, reward or toast is installed in the ordinary cases
declared.diagnostic: diagnostic cases forge only their named bot accepted/progress/ready state; they are labelled and are not ordinary gameplay or normal-history claims

priorFindings.finding: PlayerState.tradeOffers, tradeStats and tradeUsed are ordinary synced fields (noSync:false); every client can read another player's rolled stat offers and applied deltas.
priorFindings.boundary: This is a separate prior source finding. It does NOT authorize Rust to disclose rolled owner offers; the native public/observation contract remains the lead/root decision.

limits: Source-only: no native rh-sim run, no Room/socket/session, no Unity/browser/UI, no protocol-13 wire codec, no real profile connection or join.
The human departure in the bot-only camp world uses a real player attack, but the camp clear itself is a declared whole-region killMob producer, not a player-fought camp.

Two humans both ready on one kill offer was not produced by real player combat in this bounded packet; the ordinary unreachables cover the actual collect and fetch token/parcel rules, and the kill path used here credits no player.
Bots are declared addPlayer seats; no BotManager, policy, profile, account, socket or dependency on host services runs.
